attributes.additional_details:
We believe the UK is at a critical moment for the arts.

When we say “the arts are dying,” we mean the growing loss of opportunities for young people to discover their creativity, develop their voices and build careers in the creative industries.

As an agency industry representative, we want to be one of the first to step forward and help change that.

We are advocates for young people. We believe they should have the opportunity to save the industry!
attributes.background: Agency Industry Rep believes the government must protect and invest in the arts. Young people need creative spaces to express themselves, discover their potential, and build a brighter future. Investing in the arts means investing in our young people, our communities, and our future.

rejection.details: We don't really know for the text of your petition what the specific actions are which you are calling on the Government to undertake.
